newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris to decide Thomson buyer in 5/6 weeks.
newsitem.headline: Paris to decide Thomson buyer in 5/6 weeks.

text.p: The French government expects to decide within five or six weeks who will buy state-owned electronics group Thomson SA, a Defence Ministry official said on Thursday.

Marwan Lahoud, responsible for industrial affairs, research and arms in the office of Defence Minister Charles Millon, asked by reporters about the Thomson privatisation, said, "...in the next five or six weeks."
The Lagardere conglomerate and Alcatel Alsthom engineering group are rival bidders for Thomson, which is being sold in a state restructuring of the defence industry.
The government announced in February it was privatising Thomson to create a national defence electronics champion.
Thomson SA owns 58 percent of defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF and 100 percent of the consumer electronics unit Thomson Multimedia.

Lagardere wants to buy Thomson SA and keep Thomson-CSF and has lined up Daewoo Electronics of South Korea to buy loss-making Thomson Multimedia. Alcatel has said it would retain the whole Thomson business.
